name: MLSC 4351
title: Transfusion Services
description: Human blood groups, HLA antigens, compatibility testing, donor selection, and their relationship to transfusion and transplantation. Evaluation of laboratory results for selection of blood components for therapy.
requirement_description: A grade of C or better in AH 3121; open only to Medical Laboratory Sciences majors and Medical Laboratory Sciences certificate students; others with consent of Medical Laboratory Sciences Program Director.
